items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries report (hamstring).
items.why: Official Friday report via ETR compilation; hamstring, second straight miss.
items.implication: Houston WRs/TE elevated; Schultz primary beneficiary on targets/routes.
items.opportunity: TE/WR target share spike sans Collins

items.text: Rico Dowdle listed OUT; Jaylen Warren QUESTIONABLE on ETR Sunday injuries.
items.why: Toe injury; Steelers RB coach confirms Warren will lead group.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back with checkdown upside vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + routes/checkdowns for Warren; Homer/Heidenreich backups

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday’s game (elbow).
items.why: Elbow dislocation; surgery/IR not on table per GM, week-to-week positive longer-term.
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin volume intact but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and WAS pass-catchers short-term

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful (hip); McVay believes return next week vs Eagles barring setback. Sam Darnold off IR/report, good to go.
items.why: No practice; hip/groin; expected back Week 4.
items.implication: Adams elevated target share; Darnold ACTIVE boosts SEA.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams volume spike; SEA WRs with Darnold

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate; projs live and updating for news. Only CMC had similar base before.
items.why: Sim ceiling average of elite outcomes; DET offense pace/role.
items.implication: Elite weekly upside RB1; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry ceiling in favorable spot

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Split backfield restored; reverse prior Coleman beneficiaries.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RB group; expect checkdown spam as vertical pass game failed for Rodgers. Homer + rookie Heidenreich as backups.
items.why: RB coach quote + Dowdle OUT; Rodgers checkdown need.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with receiving upside vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Lead snaps/carries + high target share via checkdowns

items.text: Packers WRs sans Jayden Reed (TNF): Watson 45 routes, Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% of Love targets YTD.
items.why: First game without Reed (neck/back); route data.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 career games); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util); AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: IR expectation; Hubbard utilization already strong.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: High carry/goal-line share vs weak run D

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util (86); PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

LOVE Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yds); Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT; LV worst yds/rec to WRs); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts).

HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR FP allowed, low WAS total).
items.why: Role erosion + tough matchups; Henderson snap spike noted in Facts.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising snaps post-fumble; Hubbard full lead post-Brooks IR
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson short-term

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share). TPRR: 33% with London off, 17% with London on. Long-time fade (despite prior outlier).
items.why: Route/target data YTD; London on-field suppression.
items.implication: Fade Pitts; London dominates ATL targets.
items.opportunity: London high share; Pitts limited even if routes rise
